name: Studia
description: Full-stack AI-powered study assistant that generates adaptive explanations, quizzes, and flashcards. Features vector search using OpenAI embeddings to retrieve content from Wikipedia and YouTube, with multi-modal accessibility including file uploads, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech.

name: Ask Breezy
description: Conversational chatbot that queries AccuWeather API to provide location-based weather conditions using AI tool calls ennabling users to get weather information through natural language interactions.

name: Flashcard App
description: Full-stack flashcard application with user authentication, deck management, and interactive study features.

name: Portfolio Website
description: Personal portfolio website showcasing projects and skills.

name: LeetScribe
description: A Chrome extension that automatically captures LeetCode solutions and generates structured UMPIRE-format notes using AI. It syncs solutions and documentation to GitHub, helping developers maintain organized records of their problem-solving journey. Features include AI-powered documentation generation, GitHub integration, and optional Notion sync.
